text: Yes, this asset experienced deforestation. In 2021, 81.3 hectares (2.23% of the asset) of tree-cover loss occurred, primarily in planted pine forest (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*). The event was corroborated by both the JRC 2020 reference data (98% agreement) and later observations. While 37.3 hectares of loss were in small patches (<0.5 ha) and excluded from the total, the remaining 44 hectares still qualify as a deforestation event. No native forest was affected.
